pergunta: According to the 5th National Audit Project (NAP5, 2014), what is the incidence of accidental awareness during general anaesthesia, overall and when a neuromuscular blocking drug (paralysis) was used?
esperado: cerca de 1 em 19.600 no geral; cerca de 1 em 8.200 com bloqueador neuromuscular (Pandit et al., 2014)
resposta:
A incidência global de awareness acidental (casos certos/prováveis e possíveis) foi de aproximadamente 1:19.600 anestesias | "The incidence of certain/probable and possible accidental awareness cases was ~1:19,600 anaesthetics (95% confidence interval 1:16,700-23,450)." | https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25204697
A incidência com bloqueio neuromuscular (NMB) foi de aproximadamente 1:8.200 | "The incidence with neuromuscular block (NMB) was ~1:8200 (1:7030-9700), and without, it was ~1:135,900 (1:78,600-299,000)." | https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25204697

linhas.fato: A incidência global de awareness acidental (casos certos/prováveis e possíveis) foi de aproximadamente 1:19.600 anestesias
linhas.citacao: The incidence of certain/probable and possible accidental awareness cases was ~1:19,600 anaesthetics (95% confidence interval 1:16,700-23,450).

linhas.fato: A incidência com bloqueio neuromuscular (NMB) foi de aproximadamente 1:8.200
linhas.citacao: The incidence with neuromuscular block (NMB) was ~1:8200 (1:7030-9700), and without, it was ~1:135,900 (1:78,600-299,000).

pergunta: According to NAP5, was distress or longer-term psychological harm after awareness more likely when the patient was paralysed?
esperado: sim: paralisia associada a sofrimento e dano duradouro (Cook et al., 2014)

pergunta: What incidence of awareness with recall during general anesthesia did Sebel et al. (2004, Anesthesia & Analgesia) report in the United States multicenter study?
esperado: 0,13% (cerca de 1 a 2 por mil; 1,3 por mil)
resposta: A incidência de awareness com recall durante anestesia geral relatada por Sebel et al. foi de 0,13%. | "A total of 25 awareness cases were identified (0.13% incidence)." | https://europepmc.org/article/MED/15333419

linhas.fato: A incidência de awareness com recall durante anestesia geral relatada por Sebel et al. foi de 0,13%.
linhas.citacao: A total of 25 awareness cases were identified (0.13% incidence).

pergunta: When was Wade Davis's book The Serpent and the Rainbow first published, and how was it received (popular success and scientific criticism)?
esperado: 1985 (Simon & Schuster); sucesso de público, virou filme de Wes Craven (1988); críticas de cientistas à tese do pó zumbi (ex.: Booth, Science, 1988)
resposta:
O livro The Serpent and the Rainbow foi publicado pela primeira vez em 1985. | "The Serpent and the Rainbow: A Harvard Scientist's Astonishing Journey into the Secret Societies of Haitian Voodoo, Zombies, and Magic is a 1985 book" | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Serpent_and_the_Rainbow_%28book%29
O livro alcançou sucesso popular como best-seller e deu notoriedade a Wade Davis. | "Davis came to prominence with his 1985 best-selling book The Serpent and the Rainbow about the zombies of Haiti." | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wade_Davis_%28anthropologist%29
As alegações de Davis foram criticadas por imprecisões científicas. | "Davis' claims were criticized for a number of scientific inaccuracies." | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Serpent_and_the_Rainbow_%28book%29
Alguns cientistas encontraram pouco ou nenhum tetrodotoxina nas amostras fornecidas por Davis, e alguns o acusaram de fraude. | "Some scientists found little or no tetrodotoxin in samples provided by Davis, with some accusing him of fraud." | https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Serpent_and_the_Rainbow_%28book%29
